description: Explore data, collaborate on analyses, and manage data projects in Hex. Organize analysis work and run results around data projects, preserving context for collaboration, analytical reviews, and result handoffs. For data analysts and application developers, this context helps organize work around data objects, structures, and projects. Use the available information to prepare analysis or maintenance work and connect data understanding with development and result review. Available data and operations depend on the current connection configuration, account permissions, and service plan.
description_cn: 通过 Hex 管理数据项目、运行结果和分析工作区。适合围绕数据项目整理分析过程和运行结果，为团队协作、分析复查与结果交接保留项目背景。面向数据分析与应用开发团队，可围绕数据对象、结构和项目背景组织工作，将相关信息整理为分析或维护依据，衔接数据理解、开发准备与结果复核。具体可用的数据与操作范围以当前连接配置、账号权限及服务套餐为准。
